intelligence.enrichment: Gas can be compressed because there are large spaces between its particles; pushing the plunger forces the gas particles closer together and decreases the volume of air. external push on the plunger -> gas particles forced closer -> decreased air volume The learner explains that closing the syringe prevents escape and pushing the plunger decreases air volume by forcing gas particles closer together in their large interparticle spaces. Compressed air must have leaked out, because the same gas cannot occupy a smaller volume.
